thread:
Maya: Quick pass on Compliance settings mock. Two things: region fallback messaging and the retention 'Custom' slider. PTAL.

Jorge: For fallback banner, current copy 'Using fallback region: us-west-2' is too terse. Suggest: 'Selected region unavailable. Requests will be processed in us-west-2 temporarily.' Add 'Learn more' link about residency. Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce it.

Lee: Also clarify 'temporarily' and avoid implying mirrored residency. Maybe: 'Processed temporarily in us-west-2; original region prioritized when capacity returns.'

Maya: Updated copy: 'Selected region unavailable. Requests processed in us-west-2 until capacity returns. Learn more.' Change banner color to info blue (not orange) and add shield icon for compliance.

Sam: For the slider: screen readers reading percent is useless. Add aria-valuetext like 'Retention duration: 120 days', role=slider, min=1, max=365, step=1. Keyboard: arrows = 1 day, shift+arrow = 30 days. Also expose a numeric input next to it.

Priya: Expose presets as radios (30d, 90d, 365d, Custom). When Custom selected focus moves to numeric input. Helper copy should read 'Longer retention preserves more logs and may increase storage cost.'

Jorge: Audit export headers inconsistent. Standardize to 'actor, action, timestamp_utc, tz_offset, resource, details' and use ISO8601 Z for timestamp. UI shows local timezone but export normalizes to UTC.

Lee: Add copy affordance for audit rows. Button with aria-label="Copy audit row" that copies canonical CSV row. Also make audit row text clearer: 'Actor Jane Doe (admin) updated retention from 30d to 365d (policy: org-default)'.

Maya: Great notes. I'll update mocks and push an a11y checklist + export spec.

audit-bot: A11y checklist attached: https://redwood.internal/a11y/checklists/1718432100 (auto).

Sam: Will run keyboard/lightbox checks after you push. Thanks!
